title: Goal connection kind
description: A template for an organization's connections (spec 4 §4.2): the fields an admin fills in, which are secret, and what a run's box gets. Strings may hold {{field}} and, in a kind with mint, {{minted.<name>}}; MCP header values may also hold ${NAME}, one of the kind's env variables, which Claude Code expands in the box; nothing else is evaluated. Secret fields may appear only in env values, a test's headers and its basic password.

name.description: Slug, unique among the platform's kinds and the organization's.

fields.description: What an admin fills in. Secret fields are write-only: never shown again, sealed under the master key.

env.description: Environment variables of a run's box, for API calls, CLIs and stdio MCP servers. GOAL_*, HOME, PATH, USER, SHELL, the proxy variables, NODE_USE_ENV_PROXY, CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR, LD_* and MISE_* are reserved.

tool.description: A mise tool spec the box installs at prepare.

git.description: git over https to host, the password from one of env's variables.

mcp.description: A remote MCP server called from the box (url, headers naming env variables as ${NAME}), or a stdio server the worker starts inside the box with env (command).

model.description: Gives Claude Code its model; only such a kind may be a factory's runtime.modelConnection.

codeHost.description: The CodeHost adapter that reads and merges its pull requests.

mint.description: Mints per-run credentials from the stored ones; {{minted.<name>}} names them.

sync.description: The reader of synced knowledge sources.

test.description: The request that tells whether a connection works.

docs.description: How agents use the connection; part of their prompt, never templated.
